title: Training Sheet: The Pet Turnover Addition to the Short-Stay Share (Roamhaven Listings)
content:
# Training Sheet — Pet Turnover Addition

*Host Support training, Roamhaven Listings.*

## The rule

When the short-stay cleaning fee of a listing is saved, the approved Host Damage Protection (HostCover) claims in the pet damage category filed on the listing within the last twenty-four months (fewer than twenty-four whole months before the day of the save) are counted. When two or more were filed, **0.06** is added to the listing's short-stay share; when exactly one was, **0.03** is added; when none was, nothing is added.

## Questions and answers

**Which claims count?**
Only HostCover claims in the pet damage category, approved by the claims team, filed on that listing within the window.

**Three approved pet-damage claims in the window?**
That is "two or more": 0.06.

**One approved pet-damage claim and one still awaiting the guest?**
Only the approved one counts: 0.03.

**An approved pet-damage claim filed on the host's other listing?**
It is not filed on this listing and does not count.

**No pet-damage claim at all?**
Nothing is added.
